tools.description: Verify if a Docling document is already converted and in the local cache.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

tools.name: is_document_in_local_cache
tools.title: Is Docling document in cache

tools.description:
Convert a document of any type from a URL or local path and store in local cache.

    This tool takes a document's URL or local file path, converts it using
    the configured converter (remote API or local), and stores the resulting
    Docling document in a local cache. It returns an output with a boolean
    set to False along with the document's unique cache key. If the document
    was already in the local cache, the conversion is skipped and the output
    boolean is set to True.

source.description: The URL or local file path to the document. Object-storage URIs (abfs://, az://, gcs://, gs://, s3://) are supported when the matching provider extra is installed.
source.title: Source

tools.name: convert_document_into_docling_document
tools.title: Convert document into Docling document

tools.description:
Convert all files from a local directory path and store them in local cache.

    This tool takes a local directory path, converts every file in the directory using
    the configured converter (remote API or local) and stores the resulting Docling
    documents in a local cache. It returns a list of conversion outputs, where each
    output consists of a boolean set to False along with a document's unique cache key.
    If a document was already in the local cache, the conversion is skipped and the
    output boolean is set to True.

source.description: The path to a local directory
source.title: Source

tools.name: convert_directory_files_into_docling_document

from_cache.description: Whether the document was served from the local cache.
from_cache.title: From Cache

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

tools.title: Convert files from directory into Docling document

tools.description:
Create a new Docling document from a provided prompt string.

    This function generates a new document in the local document cache with the
    provided prompt text. The document is assigned a unique key derived from an MD5
    hash of the prompt text.

prompt.description: The prompt text to include in the new document.
prompt.title: Prompt

tools.name: create_new_docling_document
tools.title: Create new Docling document

tools.description:
Export a document from the local document cache to markdown format.

    This tool converts a Docling document that exists in the local cache into
    a markdown formatted string, which can be used for display or further processing.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

max_size.description: The maximum number of characters to return.
max_size.title: Max Size

tools.name: export_docling_document_to_markdown
tools.title: Export Docling document to markdown format

tools.description:
Save a document from the local document cache to disk in both markdown and JSON formats.

    This tool takes a document that exists in the local cache and saves it to the specified
    cache directory with filenames based on the document key. Both markdown and JSON versions
    of the document are saved.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

tools.name: save_docling_document
tools.title: Save Docling document

tools.description:
Generate a thumbnail image for the requested page.

    This tool takes a document that exists in the local cache and generates a thumbnail image for the requested page.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

page_no.description: The number of the page starting at 1
page_no.title: Page No

size.description: The width of the thumbnail in pixels
size.title: Size

tools.name: page_thumbnail
tools.title: Generate the thumbnail of a page in the Docling document

tools.description:
Add or update the title of a document in the local document cache.

    This tool modifies an existing document that has already been processed
    and stored in the local cache. It requires that the document already exists
    in the cache before a title can be added.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

title.description: The title text to add or update to the document.
title.title: Title

tools.name: add_title_to_docling_document
tools.title: Add or update title to Docling document

tools.description:
Add a section heading to an existing document in the local document cache.

    This tool inserts a section heading with the specified heading text and level
    into a document that has already been processed and stored in the local cache.
    Section levels typically represent heading hierarchy (e.g., 1 for H1, 2 for H2).

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

section_heading.description: The text to use for the section heading.
section_heading.title: Section Heading

section_level.description: The level of the heading, starting from 1, where 1 is the highest level.
section_level.title: Section Level

tools.name: add_section_heading_to_docling_document
tools.title: Add section heading to Docling document

tools.description:
Add a paragraph of text to an existing document in the local document cache.

    This tool inserts a new paragraph under the specified section header and level
    into a document that has already been processed and stored in the cache.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

paragraph.description: The text content to add as a paragraph.
paragraph.title: Paragraph

tools.name: add_paragraph_to_docling_document
tools.title: Add paragraph to Docling document

tools.description:
Open a new list group in an existing document in the local document cache.

    This tool creates a new list structure within a document that has already been
    processed and stored in the local cache. It requires that the document already exists
    and that there is at least one item in the document's stack cache.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

tools.name: open_list_in_docling_document
tools.title: Open list in Docling document

tools.description:
Closes a list group in an existing document in the local document cache.

    This tool closes a previously opened list structure within a document.
    It requires that the document exists and that there is more than one item
    in the document's stack cache.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

tools.name: close_list_in_docling_document
tools.title: Close list in Docling document

tools.description:
Add list items to an open list in an existing document in the local document cache.

    This tool inserts new list items with the specified text and marker into an
    open list within a document. It requires that the document exists and that
    there is at least one item in the document's stack cache.

ListItem.description: A class to represent a list item pairing.

list_item_text.description: The text of a list item.
list_item_text.title: List Item Text

list_marker_text.description: The marker of a list item.
list_marker_text.title: List Marker Text

ListItem.title: ListItem

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

list_items.description: A list of list_item_text and list_marker_text items.
list_items.title: List Items

tools.name: add_list_items_to_list_in_docling_document
tools.title: Add items to list in Docling document

tools.description:
Add an HTML-formatted table to an existing document in the local document cache.

    This tool parses the provided HTML table string, converts it to a structured table
    representation, and adds it to the specified document. It also supports optional
    captions and footnotes for the table.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

html_table.description: The HTML string representation of the table to add.
html_table.title: Html Table

table_captions.description: A list of caption strings to associate with the table..
table_captions.title: Table Captions

table_footnotes.description: A list of footnote strings to associate with the table.
table_footnotes.title: Table Footnotes

tools.name: add_table_in_html_format_to_docling_document
tools.title: Add HTML table to Docling document

tools.description:
Retrieve a structured overview of a document from the local document cache.

    This tool returns a text representation of the Docling document's structure,
    showing the hierarchy and types of elements within the document. Each line in the
    output includes the document anchor reference and item label.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

tools.name: get_overview_of_document_anchors
tools.title: Get overview of Docling document anchors

tools.description:
Search for specific text and keywords within a document's anchors.

    This tool takes a string of text to search for and returns a string of all
    document anchors that contain the exact text. The search is case-insensitive.
    If the exact text is not found, the tool will search for individual keywords
    within the text, splitting it on non-alphanumeric characters. If keywords
    are found, they are listed alongside their number of occurrences in parentheses.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

text.description: The string of text to search for in the document's anchors.
text.title: Text

tools.name: search_for_text_in_document_anchors
tools.title: Search for text in Docling document anchors

tools.description:
Retrieve the text content of a specific document item identified by its anchor.

    This tool extracts the text from a Docling document item at the specified anchor
    location within a document that exists in the local document cache.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

document_anchor.description: The anchor reference that identifies the specific item within the document.
document_anchor.title: Document Anchor

tools.name: get_text_of_document_item_at_anchor
tools.title: Get text of Docling document item at anchor

tools.description:
Update the text content of a specific document item identified by its anchor.

    This tool modifies the text of an existing document item at the specified anchor
    location within a document that exists in the local document cache. It requires
    that the document already exists in the cache before a modification can be made.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

document_anchor.description: The anchor reference that identifies the specific item within the document.
document_anchor.title: Document Anchor

updated_text.description: The new text content to replace the existing content.
updated_text.title: Updated Text

tools.name: update_text_of_document_item_at_anchor
tools.title: Update text of Docling document item at anchor

tools.description:
Delete multiple document items identified by their anchors.

    This tool removes specified items from a Docling document that exists in the local
    document cache, based on their anchor references. It requires that the document
    already exists in the cache before performing the deletion.

document_key.description: The unique identifier of the document in the local cache.
document_key.title: Document Key

document_anchors.description: A list of anchor references identifying the items to be deleted from the document.
document_anchors.title: Document Anchors

tools.name: delete_document_items_at_anchors
tools.title: Delete Docling document items at anchors
